body:
Before I begin, I have only ever had Cannabis, MDMA, Bk-2C-B and alcohol
I took a dose of 100ug for my first time and 3 days later took 150ug and I did not feel a tolerance, this report is 5 days after the 2nd time
11:45 - 150ug tab under tongue
11:47 - walking shop
11:57 - slight nausea. Walking home
12:11 - music sounds better
12:21 - more nausea, slight euphoria
12:40 - moreeeee nausea, jaw clenching
12:50 - confusion, body sensations
12:51 - walking to get cannabis
1:27 - smoked a spliff
1:38 can just about type
1:42 everything looks like it's breathing, hands feel really weird
Colours mad starting to see it where it isn't
Music immense
2:42 - completely forgot I was keeping track of this shit
Finding it really hard to type
10000mph thoughts
I just laugh at them cos they make sense
Smoking a cigarette hoping I don't have to speak to anyone other than Charlotte,
No outstanding visuals just breathing and overall feel that everything is alive as well as enhanced colour and all senses enhanced
2:47 - gonna try play some zombies
3:10 - Cba to play zombies, feels like it's made me trip more tho
Mom comes and speaks to me and I really can not do it but she probs just thinks I'm stoned
4:10 - stranger from a few doors down won't leave me alone and I find it easy to retreat to my own zone but at the same time trapped
4:24 - still very high, if I look at something for more than five seconds it's magical
Smoking a cigarette
4:45 - visuals can only be described as behind the scenes
No way I can act normal without feeling really uncomfortable
No way I can act normal without feeling really uncomfortable
Uncomfortable around ppl
17:08 - zone out and realise I have more head space, space to think
But thoughts feel hard to grab as if I can just get a little bit of them as they go past but then another one already comes and it's just like come on matey,
By this point I've had 4 spliffs so about 1.5g of weed
Feels like inside of my face around jaw area is just getting tangled together all the time feels dodgy
Coming to loads of realisations
18:33 - keeping having moments where I think I'm close to baseline but then realise I'm far from it
19:42 - feel almost sober but still have this extra space in my head to think and still feeling the euphoria
Smoked 3 more spliffs since half 5
Tunnel vision
Everything more enhanced still
Hands still feel weird
When I concentrate on something it starts to slowly spin clockwise
20:32 - still have some slight visuals but feeling pretty much just really stoned now as I've smoked another 2 spliffs
Altogether I've smoked 2.5g of bud
Still have this head space
And a lot of reminiscent thoughts
Was casually watching the film robots and came across a lot of realisations while watching it
21:05 - still high off the 1P-LSD and I notice it when I speak to people because I can't help but read their mind, well it feels like I am lol
Overall sense of connectedness to the everything around me
22:14 - pretty much feel normal now just stoned and a tiny bit tipsy
(10 and a half hours)
22:50 - drum and bass for the next 20 mins
23:08 - it's almost been 12 hours since I had the tab, feeling pretty much normal
23:08 - it's almost been 12 hours since I had the tab, feeling pretty much normal
, slight headache at the back of my head and front but front is probably due to the 8+ spliffs I smoked, just had another
Very very slight visuals and euphoria from the acid, colour is still enhanced
Still have that psychedelic head space, feel a lot more comfortable speaking to ppl now still find it awkward but that's normal
23:49 - 12 hours since I took it, I am at baseline
